summary: Chargate is a Python CLI that wraps MegaLinter and adds net-new (PR-diff) finding gating: on a PR only findings the diff introduced relative to the merge-base can block; the full unfiltered SARIF is always emitted and shipped (DefectDojo / Security tab / artifact) and a CycloneDX BOM (Syft) is shipped to Dependency-Track. One `chargate` CLI backs TWO GitHub surfaces: a composite action (action.yml) and a pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-hooks.yaml). The `sarif/` subpackage is a pure, deterministic, I/O-free core; `git.py` is the only subprocess boundary. A SEPARATE deployable under broker/ mints Chargate[bot] tokens for PR-comment authorship via GitHub Actions OIDC — an AWS Lambda behind an API Gateway HTTP API, with its own pyproject and virtualenv, NOT part of the stdlib-only CLI wheel and NOT a dependency group of it.

cli.purpose: argparse dispatch for the 6 subcommands; wires git -> filter -> gate -> report -> DefectDojo/Dependency-Track/PR-comments, and the standalone install-hooks/uninstall-hooks. The only module that touches os.environ + file writes + working-tree reads (SOPS) for the CLI flow.

sarif.filter.purpose: CROWN JEWEL. Classify each SARIF result as net-new vs pre-existing against a DiffIndex under a FilterPolicy; return a pruned deep copy (net-new only) + per-result verdicts + Counts. Never mutates the input. Pure, no I/O. ResultVerdict carries the finding `message` + an `inline_safe` flag (added-line/new-file only) for picking valid inline PR-comment targets. A secret-scanner hit on a SOPS-encrypted value (via an optional SopsIndex + FilterPolicy.ignore_sops_encrypted, default on) is dropped as a false positive (reason `sops-encrypted`). In-source suppressed results are surfaced as a distinct count and never gate.

sarif.sops.purpose: Detect SOPS-encrypted values (`ENC[AES256_GCM,...]`) so secret scanners don't gate on them — a 100% false positive. Pure (stdlib `re` only): turns file text into the set of encrypted line numbers, wrapped in a SopsIndex the filter consults. A plaintext value in the same file matches nothing and still gates. File reading is an IO concern handled by cli.py (mirrors how git.py feeds a DiffIndex).

sarif.diff.purpose: Parse `git diff --unified=0 -M -C` text into a DiffIndex: per-file status (added/modified/deleted/renamed/copied) + added line ranges on the new side, read from hunk headers only. Pure.

sarif.model.purpose: Defensive, typed accessors over SARIF 2.1.0 result objects (primary uri, startLine, resolved level, security-severity, severity band, tool driver name, in-source suppression, and a best-effort `is_secret_result` classifier for the SOPS filter). Tolerates missing/None fields. Pure.

sarif.counts.purpose: Tally totals + net-new + suppressed + sops_ignored + per-level + per-severity-band breakdowns. Takes net-new/suppressed/sops (run_index, result_index) keys (not verdicts) to avoid an import cycle with filter; pre_existing = total - net_new - suppressed - sops_ignored. Pure.

git.purpose: The ONLY git/subprocess boundary. Resolve merge-base(base, head), produce unified-diff text, detect shallow clones, and fail loudly with a fetch-depth hint. Keeps sarif/ pure.

gate.purpose: Turn a FilterResult into a pass/fail GateDecision against a fail_on threshold (any|critical|high|medium|low|none). Owns the exit-code constants and effective-severity-band logic.

megalinter.purpose: Build the MegaLinter env (DISABLE_ERRORS=true so it never gates; SARIF/JSON reporters on; normalized URIs; REPORT_OUTPUT_FOLDER ABSOLUTE under /tmp/lint, or the merged SARIF is written inside the container and destroyed by --rm) + the docker run command; detect the Docker DAEMON architecture and plan the run: the amd64-only flavor image, or MegaLinter multi-arch per-linter megalinter-only-* images merged back into one SARIF (arm64), or a precise error naming every way out. Images default to ghcr.io because Docker Hub is frozen at v9.4.0. Planning/env/command assembly are pure/testable; the runner is injectable.

linters.purpose: Version-pinned table of MegaLinter standalone (megalinter-only-*) images: which linters have an arm64 manifest at DEFAULT_TAG, and which can emit SARIF (one that cannot is invisible to the gate, so running it is pure cost). Plus the per-flavor substitution set used when the amd64-only flavor image cannot run. Re-verified against the live registry by tests/test_linters_registry.py.

defectdojo.purpose: Optional, first-class DefectDojo import/reimport client (urllib + multipart). Always ships the FULL SARIF, prefixed with a findings-free `chargate` identity run: DefectDojo types a Test from runs[0].tool.driver.name alone and MegaLinter's merged report has no stable first run, so without it reimport 400s with 'Test type mismatch'. Retries once against import-scan when an older, differently-typed Test is already in the engagement. Failure-isolated: import_sarif NEVER raises, returns ok=False so a DD failure can't fail the gate. Sends a chargate/<version> User-Agent (Cloudflare BIC workaround).

dependencytrack.purpose: Optional CycloneDX BOM upload client (urllib + multipart) — the supply-chain analog of defectdojo.py. POSTs the Syft-generated BOM to `/api/v1/bom` (strips the UTF-8 BOM marker), auto-creates the project/version, and resolves a project link for the PR-comment footer. Failure-isolated: upload_bom NEVER raises, returns ok=False. Upload runs on push/tags only (DT tracks shipped artifacts).

github_comment.purpose: Optional GHAS-style PR review-comment client (urllib, JSON). Posts net-new findings as ONE updatable summary comment (hidden-marker upsert) + inline review comments (delete-then-recreate, no stacking). Failure-isolated: post_pr_feedback NEVER raises, returns ok=False so a GitHub API error can't fail the gate. Pure transport; comment bodies are rendered by report.py.

install_hooks.purpose: Global git-hook installer (backs `chargate install-hooks`/`uninstall-hooks`). Generates pre-commit + pre-push + commit-msg dispatchers repointed at a global ~/.pre-commit-config.yaml, sets core.hooksPath (retroactive across existing repos) + init.templateDir (new clones), inside a regenerated `>>> chargate-managed >>>` block that preserves the user's own repos. uninstall restores/unsets the prior config. Runner + git-config probes injectable for tests.

modes.purpose: Resolve run mode from an explicit flag or GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: PR (net-new gate) vs BASELINE (full scan, no gate). Mode.gates says whether to apply the gate.

report.purpose: Output helpers: render the Markdown job summary + the PR summary/inline comment bodies (all pure, testable) + append to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY and write key=value GITHUB_OUTPUT (no-ops off Actions).

local.purpose: Fast pre-commit staged-file runner (gitleaks + ruff, each skipped if the tool is absent). Data-driven check registry; runner + which probes injectable. Deliberately narrower than CI.

broker.purpose: OIDC token broker for Chargate[bot] PR-comment authorship. A SEPARATE deployable with its own pyproject + virtualenv (NOT a dependency group of the root project). `POST /token` verifies a GitHub Actions OIDC token (issuer-pinned, audience `chargate`, `repository` claim must equal owner/repo) and mints a short-lived Chargate App installation token scoped to that repo with `pull_requests: write` only. broker.py=the decision ladder (framework-free), lambda_handler.py=API Gateway routing, main.py=FastAPI dev shell, config.py=frozen-dataclass BrokerConfig, ssm.py=Parameter Store reads, oidc.py=verify_oidc_token, github.py=app_jwt+mint_installation_token. Runs as an AWS Lambda; Terraform lives in magmamoose/infra under terraform/aws/chargate/.

broker.build.purpose: The ONE definition of what ships to Lambda: app/ minus main.py plus the resolved pyjwt[crypto] and httpx wheels. Deterministic (fixed timestamps/modes, sorted walk) so a changed digest is the publish signal. `--platform` is required with no default.

sarif.dedup.purpose: Collapses duplicate findings reported by more than one linter at the same location.

callgraph_highlights.note: The full CI flow. Baseline mode skips the diff + gate (filters against an empty DiffIndex, fail_on=none) and uploads the BOM to Dependency-Track (push/tags only). PR comments (net-new only) post on gate mode and never fail the gate. A MegaLinter tool error only fails the job under --strict. Both external sinks are active iff their host/URL is set and never fail the gate.
The pure-ish filter subcommand: SARIF + base/head -> filtered SARIF + counts + gate exit code. Unit-tested in isolation from Actions.
classify_results -> _classify_one applies FilterPolicy per result; filter_sarif deep-copies and prunes runs[].results[] to the net-new keep-set.
The handoff from the IO boundary to the pure core: diff text in, DiffIndex out.

Reached from lambda_handler.handler (API Gateway) or main.create_app (dev). Verify OIDC -> match `repository` claim -> mint scoped installation token. Emits exactly one structured outcome line per request.

note_for_agents: Load this file on demand to locate code; it is NOT auto-imported into CLAUDE.md. Design rule: sarif/ stays pure (no subprocess/os/Actions imports) so it is unit-tested with synthetic diff text + SARIF dicts. Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 blocking net-new, 2 setup/tool error (a broken scanner is a tool error, never a finding). Tests mirror modules 1:1 under tests/ (e.g. test_sarif_filter.py, test_gate.py, test_dependencytrack.py, test_install_hooks.py). The broker/ FastAPI service is a separate deployable (own dep-group + tests under broker/tests) deployed via k8s/ + Flux — keep its deps out of the stdlib-only CLI. hooks/ holds the non-Docker file-hygiene hook scripts (actions-pin-sha, conventional-branch-name) fetched by pre-commit at the pinned rev; scripts/request-app-token.sh is the action-side OIDC->broker exchange.
